rows.name: Live update running containers
rows.offer: Copies changed files into a running container and runs steps there, avoiding a full image rebuild.

rows.name: Run host commands as resources
rows.offer: Runs arbitrary commands and long-lived servers on the host (serve_cmd) as managed resources, with optional file triggers.

flisk.reason: Flisk runs services with a `command` as host processes only in the no-Docker mode, not alongside containers, and has no free-form local command resource.

rows.name: Startup order between resources
rows.offer: Lets you declare that a resource waits until another has been ready, and pulls in transitive dependencies when you start one.

rows.name: Readiness checks gate dependents
rows.offer: Dependents only start once a resource passes its readiness probe or health check.

rows.name: Start only some resources
rows.offer: Start named resources only, plus whatever they depend on, instead of the whole system.

rows.name: Many Tiltfiles and repos
rows.offer: Composes one dev environment from service definitions spread over several folders or repositories.

rows.name: Adopt an existing compose file
rows.offer: Points at an existing docker-compose file and layers dashboard control and live updates on top of it.

rows.name: Manual update control
rows.offer: Resources can be switched so file changes only mark them pending and rebuild when you press a button.

flisk.reason: The engine reads a TILT_TRIGGER_MODE environment variable, but there is no flag, service.json field or documented per-service setting.

rows.name: Trigger a resource from the CLI
rows.offer: A single command forces an update of one resource of a running environment.

rows.name: Custom action buttons in UI
rows.offer: Adds buttons to the dashboard that run a local command, such as re-running an install or resetting data, optionally with inputs.

flisk.reason: One-click project actions (reset DB, reseed, re-run codegen) fit the inner loop; docs/data.md only offers manual shell recipes today.

rows.acceptance: A `buttons` entry in service.json or project.json generates a Tilt cmd_button; proved by generator code under runtime/engine/topologies/tilt, a docs/service-json.md section, and `flisk config verify` passing on a fixture.

ice.basis: Impact: data reset and seed are common manual chores (docs/data.md) but shell scripts cover them; confidence: Tilt documents the feature and its inputs well; ease: the Tiltfile is generated in runtime/engine/topologies/tilt, but a new manifest field, schema and drift contract are needed.

rows.name: Batch mode that exits by result
rows.offer: Runs the whole environment non-interactively and exits non-zero if a build fails or a server crashes, success when all are healthy.

flisk.reason: `flisk up --json` waits for readiness and docs/ci.md polls /health, but there is no one-command run-and-exit mode that fails on any crash.

rows.name: Toggle resources while running
rows.offer: Enable or disable named resources, or all resources with a label, in a running environment without restarting it.

flisk.reason: Switching services on and off during a session saves restarts when a large system only needs part of it at a time.

rows.acceptance: `flisk enable|disable <service...>` command and a matching MCP tool, listed in cli/src/commands and cli/src/mcp/tools.ts, proven by an e2e test that stops one service without touching the rest.

ice.basis: Impact: large stacks and agent sessions often need a subset, which is why `--only` exists; confidence: the Tilt command is documented and the same engine runs underneath; ease: `flisk ui` already shows enabled state but regeneration and drift rules make runtime toggling non-trivial.

rows.name: Per-developer options without restart
rows.offer: Lets each developer pass options, store them in a config file and change them on a running environment.

flisk.reason: Flisk takes `--only`, `--env-file` and a project `.env` at start, but options cannot be changed on a running stack.

rows.name: Save and share a state snapshot
rows.offer: Saves the current environment state and logs to a file that someone else can open later to debug or add context to a bug report.

flisk.reason: A one-file bundle of status, recent logs and doctor output would make bug reports and agent hand-offs reproducible.

rows.acceptance: `flisk snapshot create [file]` (or an MCP tool `snapshot_create`) writes JSON combining status, logs and doctor output; proved by a command in cli/src/commands and a test that reads the file back.

ice.basis: Impact: debugging hand-offs between people and agents are a recurring cost; confidence: Tilt documents the CLI behaviour but the best Flisk shape is open; ease: status, logs --json and doctor --json already exist, so it is mostly composition in cli/src/commands.

rows.name: Wait for a resource condition
rows.offer: A command blocks until chosen resources reach a condition such as Ready, for use in scripts.

flisk.reason: Scripts and agents can only poll `flisk status --json`; a blocking wait fits automation of a stack that is already running.

rows.acceptance: `flisk wait [service...] --timeout` exits 0 when healthy, listed in cli/src/commands and as an MCP tool, proven by a unit test against a status fixture.

ice.basis: Impact: polling status works today, so this is a convenience; confidence: Tilt marks the command experimental; ease: status already computes health in cli/src/commands/status.ts.

rows.name: Log query command
rows.offer: Reads logs of a running environment with follow, tail, time window, source (build or runtime) and JSON output.

flisk.reason: Flisk logs supports service, tail, since, unhealthy-only and JSON, but has no follow mode or build versus runtime source filter.

rows.name: Dashboard of all resources
rows.offer: A web dashboard shows every resource, its status, logs and errors in one place.

rows.name: Query environment state
rows.offer: Exposes the live state of every resource through an API and CLI so scripts can read it as JSON.

rows.name: Diagnostics for bug reports
rows.offer: Prints information about the Tilt environment to attach to bug reports.

rows.name: Shared Tiltfile extensions
rows.offer: Teams load community or in-house Starlark snippets, such as extra checks and helpers, into their Tiltfile.

flisk.reason: The generated Tiltfile is not meant to be edited, so users cannot add extensions; `flisk eject` hands the Starlark over.

rows.name: Group resources with labels
rows.offer: Resources carry labels so the dashboard can group them, such as backend and frontend.

flisk.reason: Flisk groups services by stack and the Tilt UI shows them, but there is no user label field on a service.

rows.name: New hire starts with one command
rows.offer: Anyone on the team can start the whole app with a single command from the checked-in config.

rows.name: Tear the environment down
rows.offer: A separate command removes the containers a session left running.

rows.name: Deploy to Kubernetes clusters
rows.offer: Builds and applies Kubernetes YAML, Helm or Kustomize output to a local or remote cluster during development.

flisk.reason: Flisk is a Docker-and-processes local runtime and leaves cluster deployment to the user's Kubernetes workflow (docs/scope.md).

rows.name: Choosing a local cluster
rows.offer: Compares kind, Docker Desktop, minikube, k3d and others to run Kubernetes locally.

flisk.reason: Flisk does not need or provision a Kubernetes cluster, so cluster choice advice does not apply.

rows.name: Starlark editor support
rows.offer: Ships a language server for editing Tiltfiles with completion and diagnostics.

flisk.reason: Flisk users edit service.json, not Starlark, so editor support for the Tiltfile is not a Flisk surface.
